linked_process_id.description: Identifier of the linked process (do not modify).

analysis_status.description: Status of the AKTA analysis run.

analysis_timestamp.description: Timestamp when analysis results were collected for DB commit (UTC).

summary.description: Key summary metrics from AKTA analysis.

files_processed.description: Number of result files created by the analysis.

peaks_detected.description: Number of peaks detected in the UV trace.

experiment_json_source.description: Source location used for the experiment JSON (root_or_data_folder).

data_files.description: Paths to data output files generated by the analysis.

timeseries_csv.description: Absolute path to AKTA time-series CSV file.

peaks_csv.description: Absolute path to peak table CSV file (if peaks detected).

analysis_results_json.description: Absolute path to raw analysis_results_<id>.json produced by analysis script.

chromatogram_png.description: Absolute path to chromatogram PNG file.
